description: Source-of-Wealth / Source-of-Funds evidence pack: given a wealth-origin type (e.g. business_sale, inheritance, ipo_liquidity_event, real_estate_sale, employment_income, crypto_asset_gains) and an optional destination context (a CBI/RBI programme, generic private-bank onboarding, trustee acceptance, or EU AML account-opening), returns the documentary evidence typically required — core + corroborating documents, the context overlay (programme SoF requirements + extra due-diligence), and common red flags. Grounded in FATF/Wolfsberg standards + programme due-diligence rules. INFORMATION ONLY — lists the evidence usually required, never asserts a case is compliant. Call with no args to list available origins and contexts.

context.description: Free-text background about the applicant's situation, used to tailor the answer.

origin.description: Country the applicant is relocating FROM, as a country name.

name: build_sow_pack

outputSchema.description: Mirabello response envelope. Tool-specific fields vary; the provenance/disclaimer envelope is always present.

book_url.description: Link to request a consultation with a Mirabello specialist, for a personal case.

data_updated.description: Date the underlying dataset was last updated.

disclaimer.description: Information, not legal/tax/financial/immigration advice; figures indicative.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be fulfilled.

source.description: Attribution for the data, when it is not Mirabello Consultancy itself.

title: Build Source-of-Wealth Pack
